listing.name: Mushihimesama (Xbox 360) — Mushi Recomp (beebs1998-repo)
listing.summary: An initial playtest is reported; broad progression coverage unknown. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Mushihimesama (Xbox 360) Xbox 360 complete extracted game files, including the original executable. Default.xex plus res/DISKDATA; extra mode needs own DLC.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Build runtime and mode DLLs from public source; own Mushihimesama data is required to run, and extra mode needs own DLC.

warnings: An initial playtest is reported; broad progression coverage unknown.
